review_method: direct pixel inspection at thumbnail and native scale

gates.visible_evidence: Only two foreground adults are present. The woman's rightward eye line, turned face, extended right arm, and film-canister transfer all terminate at the single adult man on frame right.
gates.substitute_confusion: This is not an ambiguous camera stare: her pupils and face point away from the lens toward the visible man's face, while the canister-and-hand axis joins the same pair.

gates.visible_evidence: At native scale the woman's alert pupils and head turn toward the man, but both blazer lapels and the broad chest-and-shoulder plane remain substantially frontal to the camera.
gates.substitute_confusion: The extended arm supplies a strong directional gesture, but an arm direction cannot substitute for the required visible convergence of irises, head, and torso on the same target.

gates.visible_evidence: The woman stands at an open booth threshold and visibly extends a silver film canister over the deliberately unoccupied trolley surface toward the man.
gates.substitute_confusion: The canister is not decorative or resting on the trolley: her hand supports it in midair across the gap and presents it directly to the visible counterpart.

gates.visible_evidence: At thumbnail scale the man has stopped opposite her and extends an open hand into the space immediately below and toward the offered canister.
gates.substitute_confusion: This is not a static two-person portrait or direct-gaze-only substitute: the open receiving hand makes his response legible without facial-detail inspection.

repair_eligibility.reason: Exactly one localized gate fails while the same-target, invitation-action, and visible-consequence gates pass.
